raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00) with identical rows, so 666 rows landed instead of about 333. silver_transactions has no dedup on txn_id, which doubles the counts in silver and every gold table. txn_ids are otherwise unique (900001 to 904814, 4814 distinct), so keeping one row per txn_id is the correct fix.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
